parameters.excerpt: For each bit in 61:58, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.modal_signal: if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses which privilege mode filtering bits (MINH, SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) are read-write vs read-only-zero based on which privilege modes are implemented. This is a per-bit RO/RW choice.

parameters.excerpt: The content of these registers may be accessible from Supervisor level if the Smcdeleg/Ssccfg extensions are implemented.

parameters.reasoning: Whether mcyclecfg/minstretcfg are accessible from supervisor mode is an optional implementation choice ('may be accessible'), contingent on implementing the Smcdeleg/Ssccfg extensions.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: When all xINH bits are zero, event counting is enabled in all modes.
